description: This header defines a template interface for a Timer class within the beerocks::net namespace, used for scheduling and handling timer events, integrating with event-driven I/O via file descriptors.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A template class representing a timer interface for scheduling periodic or one-shot timer events, extending FileDescriptor, with methods for scheduling, canceling, and reading expiration counts.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules the timer for repeated execution with a specified delay and period.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Terminates the timer, preventing further executions.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the number of times the timer has expired since last read.

ctags.name: Timer
ctags.pattern: /^template <class TimeUnits = std::chrono::milliseconds> class Timer : public FileDescriptor {$/
